entries.source: Stadtarchiv Rothenburg ob der Tauber, 12_b Repertorium Urkunden, Nr. 1746
entries.german: Thomas Zweyfel bittet die Stadt, ihm den Lohn von Greussers Gerichtshandels und des Rosenbergischen Laufs wegen zu entrichten. – Konz. Pap.
entries.english: Thomas Zweyfel asks the city to pay him for the court case involving Greusser and the Rosenberg campaign. Draft, paper.

facts.subject: the Rosenbergischen Lauf
facts.content: was cited by Thomas Zweyfel as a basis for his request for payment from the city.
